title: India State Of Forest Report
definition: A biennial publication by the Forest Survey of India (FSI) under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) that assesses the forest and tree cover of India using remote sensing technology.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for Environment (Prelims) and Geography/Disaster Management (Mains). Frequently tested on trends, definitions of forest types, and state-wise rankings.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of India State Of Forest Report.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
